subject.title: [Bug]: non_deliverable_terminal_turn produces no outbound notification to channel plugins — Octo (and other channels) go silent

question: Should non-deliverable terminal turns produce an automatic core outbound fallback for channel plugins, or should OpenClaw add a plugin-owned terminal-failure hook instead?
rationale: Both viable fixes change user-visible channel delivery behavior, and the repository policy treats fallback behavior plus plugin SDK seams as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve core automatic fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback through normal outbound delivery for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, protecting current channel plugins by default.

options.title: Add plugin SDK hook
options.body: OpenClaw adds a documented terminal-failure callback so plugins control delivery, accepting new public API surface and per-plugin adoption work.

options.title: Keep plugin-owned workaround
options.body: Core leaves `message_tool_only` strict and expects Octo or other plugins to inspect run state or repair delivery in their own repositories.

recommendation.title: Approve core automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback through normal outbound delivery for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, protecting current channel plugins by default.
